The '''Rampart Mark Four''' was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] model manufactured by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that saw use during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Primarily a minelayer, the Rampart Mark Four featured extended ammunition caches and room for two types of mines, along with the baseline defenses of most gunships, a moderate sensor range, and particularly good communication systems.<ref name="GS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rampart Mark Four is one of the four bomber models available to Republic players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It costs 5,000 Fleet Requisition to unlock, and is the Republic faction's minelayer, deploying repair, missile, and sentry drones. Its Imperial counterpart is the [[M-7 Razorwire]].<ref name="GS" />
